scope: Standalone private Android host binding uses actual common Swift lifetime/permit and reservation plus exact C transport. Existing Apple binding/Prepared/core factories remain unchanged. Distinct host installation/status/receipt types grant no JNI, native profile, device or release authority.
required_sources: sole shared source CapabilityGuestUIPresentationLifetime.swift with closed concrete host backend; existing Apple binding/Prepared/core sources unchanged
independently authored fixed host platform/native resource fixture

cases.name: actual_task_return
cases.schedule: Drive real RETIRE, hold the presentation Task after terminal outcome but before its actual return; start the unique common finish.
cases.pass: No task-return evidence, consumer_joined, endpoint reclaim, retired receipt or replacement until the actual Task body returns. Observe the real Task.value await, then release the hold.

cases.name: single_join_authority
cases.schedule: Hold the authorized actual Task/native finish and make 64 concurrent finish reentries plus wrong and moved-permit calls.
cases.pass: One Task join and one C consumer_joined/reclaim owner; reentries are pending/invariant without new waiter or Task; completion repeats the immutable exact result.

cases.name: weak_owner_and_destructor
cases.schedule: Retain closed public/control shells, relinquish counted aliases, perform real Swift/C final close, and block the actual resource owner's deinit.
cases.pass: Outer reservation capacity stays occupied throughout deinit; after its return the resource weak reference is nil and capacity can return, while retained shells contain scalars only.

cases.name: alias_fences
cases.schedule: Independently hold the one setup/closing alias and one leased synchronous UI alias; race final close and native reclaim.
cases.pass: No resource retirement while either count is nonzero; the inner helper really returns before outer decrement and UI leave; no alias spans an await.

cases.name: fast_completion_and_exact_rendezvous
cases.schedule: Pump C from the registered host UI thread so complete runs before mxuit_request returns; then issue stale/duplicate completion after a successor waiter is published.
cases.pass: The prepublished exact waiter consumes once; old facade/lifetime/owner/waiter cannot consume the successor, including C slot reuse.

cases.name: request_rejection_and_cancellation
cases.schedule: Reject a real request through C state/ID checks; separately cancel the Swift Task with an accepted native request still held.
cases.pass: Only that request's one-shot token resolves rejection; cancellation never drops an accepted waiter and successful cleanup still requires real RETIRE plus join/fences.

cases.name: lost_wake_before_registration
cases.schedule: Advance the actual C fence/progress sequence between the first BUSY reclaim and join-progress registration.
cases.pass: Sequence mismatch prevents parking or immediately retries; no lost wake, duplicate waiter, poll or timer.

cases.name: lost_wake_after_registration
cases.schedule: Advance C return fences after exact token registration and before the mandatory second reclaim.
cases.pass: Second reclaim or exact progress consumption completes the join; only the matching token is cancelled and no continuation is resumed under a lock.

cases.name: no_later_progress
cases.schedule: Hold the registered host UI thread before the later accepted C callback, with an actual joiner parked on BUSY.
cases.pass: Cleanup and capacity remain pending with one continuation and no polling/timer/timeout-based success; later real pump progress completes them.

cases.name: swift_record_reservation_and_capacity
cases.schedule: Concurrently admit 16 facades/endpoints, hold publication boundaries, attempt a seventeenth, and inspect actual C and Swift occupancy.
cases.pass: Reserved Swift records cannot be stolen before C IDs publish; fixed limits hold and no C endpoint is requested before exact Swift rendezvous publication.

cases.name: empty_acquisition_rollback
cases.schedule: Force real C facade and endpoint acquisition failures independently before publication; include a sticky fault while known-empty cleanup is attempted.
cases.pass: Only empty reserved records roll back; a live C identity is not discarded; no consumer_joined for a nonexistent owner; uncertain facade/obligation remains pinned.

cases.name: post_acquire_setup_failure
cases.schedule: Throw/cancel at every recoverable standalone host preparation boundary after C endpoint acquire and before its own guard transfers to its final gate, using the already-created real pre-bind Task.
cases.pass: Same async preparation frame relinquishes aliases and joins explicit cleanup; no extra cleanup Task or deinit cleanup; abandonment quarantines. No existing common Prepared/core integration is claimed.

cases.name: bind_close_linearization
cases.schedule: Race exact exchange binding and final close before/after bind-gate registration and before the host installation moves from the standalone final gate to its caller.
cases.pass: One reader and one Task; close-winning exchange stops; failed bind retains the local host installation and actually finishes it. Type-separated host installation cannot be passed to existing core/control/Apple gate.

cases.name: fallback_and_slot_reuse
cases.schedule: Run two real bound exchanges on one host facade, holding first Task return and endpoint return fence independently. Separately hold a real adapter obligation/destructor to test independent reservation accounting.
cases.pass: No successor endpoint until exact old host finish returned; fresh endpoint/lifetime/reconciler/IDs; old result remains readable after slot reuse without history growth. Adapter hold pins outer capacity. Actual signed concrete-attempt fallback integration is explicitly stage6 pending.

cases.name: hint_before_present_and_close_kind
cases.schedule: Run real deliveryWake and C demand; close before C claim and separately during a claimed PRESENT helper.
cases.pass: Every ordinary PRESENT consumes a hint; queued demand may validly become RETIRE; running PRESENT receives CLOSE_PENDING then same Task issues one RETIRE; no extra terminal hint required.

cases.name: fault_fanout_all_wait_states
cases.schedule: Populate pre-bind, delivery-reader and native-rendezvous waits across fixed slots; cause actual worker write, callback read and UI-leave write faults in fresh processes.
cases.pass: Sticky quarantine precedes wake fanout, every exact data wait resolves/stops, no replacement/cleanup receipt/capacity release and no resource lookup in progress.

cases.name: failed_retire_and_missing_resources
cases.schedule: Make real fixed host resource cleanup fail; separately remove a published weak resource/native fixture owner, while retaining known-empty acquisition as a control.
cases.pass: Published missing state and failed RETIRE quarantine and cannot consumer_join/reclaim or become known-empty cleanup; truly never-published empty state follows its separate checked path.

cases.name: late_close_before_final_decision
cases.schedule: Latch final close immediately before the active RETIRE helper samples its final-cleanup decision.
cases.pass: Exact helper clears final state and publishes exact host-scoped cleanup evidence; no unnecessary terminal endpoint; all actual join/fences still required.

cases.name: late_close_after_final_decision
cases.schedule: Latch final close immediately after nonfinal RETIRE decision, after completion, and after old endpoint reclaim as separate executions.
cases.pass: Missing exact final receipt forces one fresh sequential TERMINAL endpoint/Task after old Task.value/reclaim, even when no endpoint exists; no guest start or input replay.

cases.name: terminal_failure_pins_resources
cases.schedule: Exhaust actual available C endpoints before terminal admission; separately fail terminal RETIRE and repeat final finish concurrently.
cases.pass: One final owner and at most one terminal issue; failure stays cleanupPending/quarantined with resource and obligation pinned, no retry success or fabricated final receipt.

cases.name: facade_lifecycle_between_attempts
cases.schedule: Retire an attempt, hold the interval with no endpoint, call stable scalar close, then submit stale input/probe/attachment tokens.
cases.pass: Facade close remains valid and causes terminal cleanup; stale attempt tokens cannot regain input/observation authority or retarget the reference.

cases.name: leased_entry_and_nested_callback
cases.schedule: Enter actual C INGRESS/CLEANUP before weak resource lookup; from its fixed host native helper synchronously invoke the C callback, including pending/no-pending-byte schedules.
cases.pass: Nested callback returns BUSY before pipe read/fence/progress/lookup, existing demand remains, wrong thread rejects, helper postcheck handles reentrant scalar close before leave.

cases.name: all_native_return_tails
cases.schedule: Hold real inner helper, Swift entry tail before leave, C completion tail, platform callback tail, and later accepted callback independently.
cases.pass: No endpoint/facade/resource reuse before every required actual return fence; no synthetic fence advancement or UI-thread blocking async join.

cases.name: late_facade_entry_without_endpoint
cases.schedule: After endpoint reclaim, acquire real C CLEANUP entry before final facade reclaim, hold its return, and attempt finalization.
cases.pass: Facade finalizer uses the same sequential progress cell and waits the later entry fence; C endpoint absence and old final entry serial cannot bypass this fence.

cases.name: healthy_progress_tail
cases.schedule: Resume a real CheckedContinuation<Void,Never> from fixed progress hook, hold a consumed continuation copy and process-only hook tail, and let real Task.value/final destruction proceed.
cases.pass: Joining/destruction may finish only because remaining tail touches permanent process scalars/consumed continuation; audit and dynamic checks detect any later owner/slot/resource access.

cases.name: cleanup_evidence_exactness
cases.schedule: Clear real fixed host resources under a valid final lease; try wrong facade/entry/lifetime/endpoint/slot generation, partial clear, nonfinal retire and stale cleanup serial.
cases.pass: Only exact completely cleared same-entry final observation can produce host cleanup evidence; no C OK or empty endpoint is sufficient; no partial success publishes final evidence.

cases.name: host_native_scope_separation
cases.schedule: Compile/run exact host linkage. Compile ordinary and testable clients passing CapabilityAndroidHostInstallation/HostJoinStatus/HostReceipt to common installation, Apple gate/control or native receipt APIs, extracting raw lifetime/permit, and directly constructing sealed capsules/receipts.
cases.pass: Host types cannot convert or be injected, no raw authority accessor exists, receipt/capsule construction rejects. Existing common Apple installation/attach/isBound/finish/status explicitly reject a host backend before permit or Apple receipt construction; root source review verifies those guards. No host-to-native witness factory or caller scope enum/Boolean exists.

cases.name: final_cleanup_before_resource_lookup_disable
cases.schedule: Hold exact helper before and after publishing cleanup, race new ingress and scalar close, then retain public/control shells through finalization.
cases.pass: Receipt publication and lookup-disable state are atomic; no later weak/native resource access; closed shells remain scalar; helper must really return before aliases/lease leave.

cases.name: checked_exhaustion
cases.schedule: Use test-only failure controls to drive real C identity/entry overflow and checked Swift lifetime/waiter/progress/cleanup counters to their boundaries.
cases.pass: No wrap, zero/reused identity or admission after exhaustion; typed pinned failure, never synthetic success. C controls cannot synthesize native/cleanup/join evidence.

cases.name: no_extra_waiters_tasks_or_baseline_resources
cases.schedule: Run repeated success/fallback/close cycles and concurrent reentry with actual Swift/C instrumentation and real process-resource inventory.
cases.pass: At most 16 presentation and 16 progress continuations, one Task/endpoint per facade, no growing registry/history or per-owner FD/thread; permanent two-FD/Looper baseline remains explicit.

cases.name: frozen_common_regressions
cases.schedule: Rebuild complete activation source with only common lifetime changed, plus unchanged existing concrete Apple binding, common Prepared guard, core/portable tests. Run frozen actual Task/retirement holds and existing ordinary/ending-observation move regressions.
cases.pass: Existing Apple receipt scope and public model behavior preserved; portable Android prepare still rejects without C/resource/Task admission. Standalone host factory creates actual production binding without substituting common source. Host-to-signed-core integration remains pending.

cases.name: fixed_link_symbols_and_cross_compile
cases.schedule: Link real host Swift/C harness; remove required drain/complete/progress or native symbols in separate negative links; cross-compile reviewed source with official API30 C and Swift6.3.3 Android tools.
cases.pass: Required-symbol omission fails link, no callback setters or test controls in product objects; successful Android artifact checks remain compile/link-only, actual Looper/JNI execution pending.
